search_scope: Twelve explicit target-relevant hypotheses spanning SSS, BWP and AMA. Not an exhaustive proof that no further property can emerge.

findings.title: Joint feasibility across product, workflow and actor constraints
findings.witness: Three Boolean pairwise inequality constraints each have solutions in pairs, but their three-way conjunction has none.
findings.novelty_adjudication: The existing reachable-joint-state and compositional-premise criteria already reject the unsupported global inference. The higher-order witness is new to this target crosswalk; a new state tuple does not establish a new normative property.
findings.target_requirement: A meaningful JOIN must inspect the supported joint configuration and interaction obligations, not count component passes.
findings.semantic_invalidation_radius: Joint configuration, workflow definition and actor interaction assumptions; retain unaffected component observations.
findings.cheap_or_non_trigger_path: Use the already adequate atomic composition contract for a single simple operation.
findings.evidence_ceiling: Analytical composition of frozen inherited criteria and finite counterexample, not empirical benefit, native runtime, installed-host or release qualification.
findings.athruk_basis: Target interpretation in ATHRUK_IMPLICATIONS.json, including each explicit cross-family bridge rationale; these are implications, not independent proof.

findings.title: Common decision identity across derivation, work instance and grant
findings.witness: Equal artifact bytes coexist with changed workflow semantics and action grant.
findings.novelty_adjudication: Cross-stage coherence and validity-preserving handoff already require compatible meanings and authority. Adding the concrete tuple is target instantiation, not proof that a digest establishes authorization.
findings.target_requirement: Bind only decision-relevant product/configuration, definition/instance, observation and principal/grant dimensions; reject an unsupported join of separately valid records.
findings.semantic_invalidation_radius: Only claims/actions depending on changed semantic or grant dimensions; preserve historical evidence at its original decision.
findings.cheap_or_non_trigger_path: One existing atomic request/effect contract may bind all necessary dimensions without extra machinery.
findings.evidence_ceiling: Analytical composition of frozen inherited criteria and finite counterexample, not empirical benefit, native runtime, installed-host or release qualification.

findings.title: Transaction independence does not establish delivery independence
findings.witness: Two distinct route IDs address the same order and send operation.
findings.novelty_adjudication: The inherited message/effect correlation and demonstrated-containment criteria already distinguish route identity from an external effect.
findings.target_requirement: Conflict and retry admission must account for logical delivery and pending/unknown effects across transactions, not only path or route uniqueness.
findings.semantic_invalidation_radius: Shared effect identities and affected recipients; independent read-only research remains available.
findings.cheap_or_non_trigger_path: Keep unrelated effect identities concurrent when current authority/resource constraints permit.

findings.title: Observation meaning cannot silently become acceptance
findings.witness: The same done token denotes performed under one definition and accepted under another.
findings.novelty_adjudication: The analytical handoff and explicit acceptance-transition criteria already forbid semantic promotion. The example supplies a concrete projection failure, not new authority.
findings.target_requirement: Preserve definition/version, observed event meaning, uncertain mappings and the receiving acceptance predicate in projections and successor capsules.
findings.semantic_invalidation_radius: Affected event/projection interpretations and downstream decisions; raw event history remains evidence.
findings.cheap_or_non_trigger_path: Do not introduce a mining engine or universal event ontology when a small typed record suffices.
findings.evidence_ceiling: Analytical composition of frozen inherited criteria and finite counterexample, not empirical benefit, native runtime, installed-host or release qualification.

findings.title: Recovery across software state, workflow remedy and recipient effect
findings.witness: Local rollback restores a value while an already received notification persists.
findings.novelty_adjudication: Returnability and compensation criteria already preserve unremedied external consequences. A constructed rollback example is not a product recovery test.
findings.target_requirement: Specify rollback, compensation, forward repair and accepted residual loss separately; reconcile exact external effects before retry or closure.
findings.semantic_invalidation_radius: Changed targets, externally affected recipients and claimed recovery guarantees.
findings.cheap_or_non_trigger_path: A reversible local-only operation may use a direct preimage restore.

findings.title: Retirement requires supported-product and in-flight-work accounting
findings.witness: No new admissions remain, but an old deployed consumer still relies on the mechanism.
findings.novelty_adjudication: Support-aware retirement, descendant disposition and live-obligation preservation already cover the combined consumer.
findings.target_requirement: Retire a helper, worker, workflow version or control only when remaining supported consumers and obligations are discharged or explicitly transferred.
findings.semantic_invalidation_radius: Retired component consumers, pending descendants, historical version support and recovery dependencies.
findings.cheap_or_non_trigger_path: Preserve an adequate old version or reclassify the control when replacement adds no value.

findings.title: Local progress assumptions can form a global wait cycle
findings.witness: Each local machine can finish if its peer has progressed; together neither first action is enabled.
findings.novelty_adjudication: No common refinement/fairness/environment model establishes a global liveness theorem. The joint-obligation criterion remains applicable; a stronger universal progress claim is unresolved.
findings.target_requirement: Separate reachable exit, soundness, deadlock freedom and inevitable completion; document real dependencies, resource assumptions and a progress/recovery path at the selected JOIN.
findings.semantic_invalidation_radius: Only progress claims and decisions depending on the circular assumption; local tests keep their original limited scope.
findings.cheap_or_non_trigger_path: An acyclic bounded case with a proved predecessor can use ordinary dependency scheduling.

findings.title: Mined relation and execution prerequisite remain different
findings.witness: Identical historical co-change sets coexist with no live prerequisite; an actual dependency changes the ready set.
findings.novelty_adjudication: Dependency typing and validity-preserving interpretation already prohibit converting correlation into execution authority.
findings.target_requirement: Keep informational, diagnostic, execution and acceptance relations typed, including relations imported from research or logs.
findings.semantic_invalidation_radius: Only scheduling edges justified by changed dependency evidence; no global serialization from shared eventual product.
findings.cheap_or_non_trigger_path: Proceed with disjoint safe work while buffering acceptance that genuinely depends on another result.

findings.title: Source and observation reuse across all three research families
findings.witness: Three reports share one originating observation.
findings.novelty_adjudication: Evidence-independence accounting already preserves common cause. The number of named fields, packets, agents or relations is not an independent-study denominator.
findings.target_requirement: Record originating work/version/data/model where it matters; retain local claim scopes and source-access limits through aggregation.
findings.semantic_invalidation_radius: Claims of corroboration, uncertainty reduction and generality using the reused source.
findings.cheap_or_non_trigger_path: Use one sufficient observation when independence would not change the decision.

findings.title: Adaptive workflow and agent-policy changes alter evaluation populations
findings.witness: Aggregate success rises from 54% to 76% while both case classes worsen because the case mix changes.
findings.novelty_adjudication: The inherited population, causal-identification and regime-transfer criteria already defeat this inference. No measured triad benefit is claimed.
findings.target_requirement: Bind configuration/definition/policy version, case mix, observation selection and comparison unit before asserting improvement; use matched or otherwise justified comparisons.
findings.semantic_invalidation_radius: Changed evaluation populations, policies, observers and downstream improvement claims.
findings.cheap_or_non_trigger_path: Retain no-change or evidence-insufficient when a worthwhile comparison is unavailable.

findings.title: Later boundaries supersede use without erasing earlier evidence
findings.witness: A valid review for generation 4 remains historical evidence but does not match generation 5.
findings.novelty_adjudication: Assumption-indexed invalidation and coherent recovery already require successor applicability. A new boundary is not retrospective falsification of the original verdict.
findings.target_requirement: Retain the original verdict and identity, then derive the affected reuse/invalidation radius for the latest boundary and actual successor decision.
findings.semantic_invalidation_radius: Only authority and evidence affected by the newer event; no replay of unrelated accepted ancestry.
findings.cheap_or_non_trigger_path: Reuse mechanically and semantically unaffected evidence at its existing scope.

findings.title: Self-revision cannot provide its own sole admission criterion
findings.witness: A successor validator accepts an action that its governing predecessor rejects.
findings.novelty_adjudication: Predecessor-governed revision and justified-reference criteria already reject circular self-authorization. The narrow formal self-modification theorem is not generalized assurance.
findings.target_requirement: Evaluate changed control criteria, event meaning and permission boundaries under admitted predecessor authority, with explicit old/new obligations and post-change evidence.
findings.semantic_invalidation_radius: Changed validators, policies, dependent evidence and action grants; earlier valid decisions remain retained.
findings.cheap_or_non_trigger_path: Leave the existing control unchanged when the proposed revision lacks warranted benefit or authority.
